key_points: Most eBay-related headlines are low-signal research summaries, generic market commentary, or unrelated legal/crime news.
Black Friday countdown may modestly support e-commerce sentiment, but it is broad and not eBay-specific.
Boom in tech resale/recommerce is a mildly positive backdrop for eBay's secondhand marketplace narrative.
No material guidance, earnings, regulatory, M&A, or management news specific to eBay appears in the set.
Combined effect should be near noise, with only a slight neutral-to-mildly-positive tilt.
